GLS.feature.token-conditions.title: Token Conditions
GLS.feature.token-conditions.hint: Replaces Foundry's token effect icons with a shader-drawn rail down the token's flank: PF2e conditions with their counters, and the effects feats, items and spells apply with their durations counting down.
GLTC.Settings.ShowEffects.Name: Show Effects
GLTC.Settings.ShowEffects.Hint: Draw the effects feats, items, spells and afflictions apply, below the conditions and separated from them by a gap. Each shows its remaining duration as a depleting gauge, and a sustained one draws that gauge in gold. Off leaves only PF2e's conditions on the rail.
GLTC.Settings.MaxPlates.Name: Plates Per Token
GLTC.Settings.MaxPlates.Hint: How many plates a rail may show before the rest collapse into a single count. Conditions are kept first. The count itself takes one of the slots, so a limit of six with eight things to show gives five plates and a +3.
GLTC.Settings.ExpiryWarn.Name: Expiry Warning
GLTC.Settings.ExpiryWarn.Hint: How many rounds before an effect ends that its plate starts to breathe, on the same slow clock the resource bar's low-health state uses. 0 turns the warning off.
GLTC.Settings.Side.Name: Rail Side
GLTC.Settings.Side.Hint: Which flank of the token the rail hangs on. It always grows downward from the token's top edge, so the worst thing a creature has is at the same place on every token.
GLTC.Settings.SuppressCore.Name: Replace Foundry's Icons
GLTC.Settings.SuppressCore.Hint: Hide Foundry's own grid of effect icons on the token, so the rail is the only reading. Turning this off shows both, which is useful for comparing them and unreadable for playing.
GLTC.Settings.Bloom.Name: Bloom
GLTC.Settings.Bloom.Hint: The post-process pass that turns the plates' brightest edges into light. Off costs one full-screen filter and leaves the plates flatter.
GLTC.Settings.OffsetX.Name: Rail Offset — Horizontal
GLTC.Settings.OffsetX.Hint: Nudge every rail sideways, in grid squares. A per-token override is available on the token itself and replaces this value rather than adding to it.
GLTC.Settings.OffsetY.Name: Rail Offset — Vertical
GLTC.Settings.OffsetY.Hint: Nudge every rail up or down, in grid squares.
GLTC.Settings.MotionTier.Name: Motion
GLTC.Settings.MotionTier.Hint: How much the plates move. Reduced halves every duration; Still draws each plate at rest with no print, no flash and no breath.
GLTC.Settings.Labels.Name: Names
GLTC.Settings.Labels.Hint: When a plate expands to show what it is. Hovering the token is the default; Always keeps every rail expanded, which reads well on a sparse map and crowds a busy one. This can never show more than you are already allowed to see.
GLTC.Settings.Scale.Name: Plate Size
GLTC.Settings.Scale.Hint: A multiplier on the size the scene's grid gives. Everything about the rail is derived from the grid, so this holds its proportion at every grid size and zoom.
